name: Sika SealTape F
paste:
SIKA® SEALTAPE F: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® SealTape F, December 2025, Version 05.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/sika-sealtape-f.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® SealTape F where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® SealTape F is an elastic system component which is used in combination with Sika®waterproofing products. It reduces the risk of leaks through potential cracking locations at wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipe entries etc.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Crack-bridging and waterproofing tape used in combination with Sika® waterproofing products for reducing the risk of leakage at locations at risk to cracking for:
    - Residential or commercial wet areas
    - Cold storage areas, car washes and catering kitchens
    - Swimming pools and water retaining structures in combination with ceramic coverings
    - Balconies and terraces
    - Interior and exterior use
    - SikaCeram Sealing Membrane A
    - SikaTile - water-based waterproofing membranes
    - Davco under tile waterproofing Membrane
    - Sikalastic 1K
    Sika® SealTape F can be used with the following suitable Sika waterproofing membranes

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® SealTape F
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Crack-bridging flexible waterproof sealing tape.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 05.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN EN ISO 527-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - DIN EN ISO 4892-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to UV exposure (p.2).
    - DIN EN 1931: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Equivalent air layer thickness for water vapour (p.2).
    - DIN EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Permanetly flexible
    - High elasticity
    - High breaking strength
    - Easy to install
    - Waterproof and watertight suitable for use in tiled pools and spas
    - Good adhesion to Sika® waterproofing products
    - Chemical resistant
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Yellow, or Grey
2.6 Composition.
    | Sealing layer | Thermoplastic elastomers (TPE) |
    | Fleece | Non woven Polypropylene |
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Length: 50 Meter roll
    - Width: 120mm
    - Chemical resistance: Chemically resistant against: Caustic Potash 3%; Acetic Acid 5%; Lactic Acid 5%; Hydrochloric Acid 3%; Sulphuric Acid 35%; Citric Acid 10%; Sea Water 20g/l sea salt
    - Resistance to UV exposure: ≥ 500 hours (DIN EN ISO 4892-2)
    - Equivalent air layer thickness for water vapour: Sd ≥ 7 m (DIN EN 1931)
    - Watertightness: ≥ 1,5 bar (DIN EN 1928, Procedure B)
    - Service temperature: -30 °C min. / +90 °C max.
2.8 Tensile strength.
    | Longitudinal | ≥ 85 N / 15 mm |
    | Lateral | ≥ 15 N / 15 mm |
    Test method printed: (DIN EN ISO 527-3)
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 50 meter roll
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - All substrates must be stable, clean, dry, free of any loose or friable particles, contaminants such as dust, dirt, oil, wax polish, grease, old adhesive residue, cement laitance or efflorescence. Smooth surfaces must be roughened lightly and dust removed to improve adhesion.
    - Surfaces shall be primed with a suitable primer prior to application. Refer to the selected Sika waterproofing membrane product data sheet for specific primer recomendations.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: ~0,66 mm
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Sika® SealTape F tape
    - Embed tape into the 1st layer of the wet Sika® waterproofing product using a smoothing trowel or spatula. To accommodate movement, a loop can be made with the tape over the crack.
    - Overlaps must be ≥ 50 mm.
    - On top of the hardened 1st layer and tape, apply a 2nd layer of the Sika® waterproofing product.
    - The middle section of the Sika® SealTape F can be left exposed with the selected waterproofing membrane bonding to a minimum 25mm over each edge of the tape. Tile adhesive can bond directly onto the Sika® SealTape F bandage.
    - Refer to the specific instruction on the product dat sheet of the selected Sika waterproofing membrane.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 05.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile strength: Longitudinal | ≥ 85 N / 15 mm; Lateral | ≥ 15 N / 15 mm (DIN EN ISO 527-3)
    - Resistance to UV exposure: ≥ 500 hours (DIN EN ISO 4892-2)
    - Equivalent air layer thickness for water vapour: Sd ≥ 7 m (DIN EN 1931)
    - Watertightness: ≥ 1,5 bar (DIN EN 1928, Procedure B)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® SealTape F, December 2025, Version 05.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/sika-sealtape-f.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
